name: Carisbamate
summary: Carisbamate (YKP 509, proposed trade name Comfyde) is an experimental anticonvulsant drug that was under development by Johnson & Johnson Pharmaceutical Research and Development but never marketed.

uses.text: Carisbamate (YKP 509, proposed trade name Comfyde) is an experimental anticonvulsant drug that was under development by Johnson & Johnson Pharmaceutical Research and Development but never marketed.

summaryZh: 卡立氨酯（英語：Carisbamate；代號：YKP 509）是一種實驗性抗驚厥藥物，由J&JPRD開發但從未上市。
summaryZhHans: 卡立氨酯（英语：Carisbamate；代号：YKP 509）是一种实验性抗惊厥药物，由J&JPRD开发但从未上市。

pharmacology.en: Its exact mechanism is not fully understood. Studies suggest it calms overactive nerve cells partly by blocking voltage-gated sodium channels, which nerve cells use to fire.
pharmacology.zh: 它確切的作用機制尚未完全清楚。研究顯示，它可能部分透過阻斷神經細胞放電所需的電壓門控鈉離子通道，讓過度活躍的神經細胞平靜下來。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它确切的作用机制尚未完全清楚。研究显示，它可能部分通过阻断神经细胞放电所需的电压门控钠离子信道，让过度活跃的神经细胞平静下来。

sideEffects.en: In clinical trials the most common effects were dizziness, sleepiness, headache and nausea.
sideEffects.zh: 在臨床試驗中，最常見的作用是頭暈、嗜睡、頭痛與噁心。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在临床试验中，最常见的作用是头晕、嗜睡、头痛与恶心。

fact.en: It was discovered by the South Korean company SK, and it is a carbamate, the same chemical family as the older drugs meprobamate and felbamate.
fact.zh: 它由韓國 SK 集團發現，屬於胺甲酸酯類，與較早的藥物甲丙氨酯（meprobamate）和非氨酯（felbamate）同一化學家族。
fact.zhHans: 它由韩国 SK 集团发现，属于胺甲酸酯类，与较早的药物甲丙氨酯（meprobamate）和非氨酯（felbamate）同一化学家族。
